papers.title: LatentPress: Context Compression Beyond Text and Vision
papers.what: Writes conversation histories and long documents into continuous memory tokens that a frozen decoder reads through its input-embedding port, hitting 0.504 on LongMemEval at 7.70x compression against 0.490 for uncompressed evidence and 0.184 for text summaries, while training only a 4.2M to 26.2M parameter adapter.

papers.title: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
papers.authors: Wang, Qiu, Zhao, Qian, Yang, Han, Ji, Savarese, Heinecke, Wang (Salesforce)
papers.what: Keeps the prompt and evicts KV cache entries uniformly at random inside each head with no scoring at all, matching the strongest prior evictor across four models and six reasoning tasks while serving 32 to 43 percent higher throughput, because the prompt is the fragile part and the reasoning trace is redundant in text and across heads.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM); DeepSeek-V2 (2024, 743XA29Y); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE)

papers.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models II: One Training Example
papers.authors: Fu, He, Zuo, Huang, Zhang et al. (Thinking Space)
papers.what: Trains on-policy distillation on a single query and still recovers most of full-data gain, because one query's rollouts already reach 71.5 percent of the states full-data training visits and 16 semantically distinct queries reach 98.9 percent, so the method is data-overfed and algorithm-starved rather than data-starved.
papers.builds_on: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? (2026, 2608.31046); Cliff (2026, 2609.02817); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE)

papers.title: Why Gated DeltaNet Survives 4-Bit Quantization: NVFP4 W4A4 for the Recurrent Half of a Hybrid 27B LLM
papers.what: Quantizes all 496 linear layers of a hybrid 27B model to 4-bit NVFP4 including the Gated DeltaNet gates that everyone else protects, matches BF16 within seed noise at 17.5 GiB and 14 to 19 percent faster prefill, and explains it by showing the delta rule overwrites the state along each new key direction so injected noise is forgotten within hundreds of steps.
